note: Scope reduced to BajajLife-approved games only. Games dropped by feedback (Compound Quest, Shield Spin) and all concepts without explicit BajajLife sign-off were removed from the repository. The former gold standard life-goals-bubble-shooter was removed; its patterns are captured in okf-brain/GAME_STANDARD.md and mirrored in the surviving games. 2026-08-03 review: Dual Cover, Goal Juggler, Ripple Shield and Time Shield were dropped and their directories deleted.

newGames.concept: Cover / Shield Placement Physics (Cover Orange style)
newGames.financialConcept: Preemptive risk protection
newGames.brief: Physics puzzle: family member characters sit on a level layout. Player drags & drops shield objects (umbrellas, crates, barrels rendered as glossy vector shapes) from a tray onto the scene. After placement (or a GO button / 3s timer), a virus storm sweeps across the top raining spiky virus particles that fall with gravity and bounce. Any family member touched by a virus is lost. Protect all members to win the round. 6 hand-designed rounds of rising complexity inside a 2-minute session, score = members saved x100 + unused shields x50 + time bonus. Simple 2D physics: gravity, AABB/circle collisions, stacking. Viruses are green spiky orbs with glow, NOT emoji.

newGames.financialConcept: Bridging coverage gaps in life journey
newGames.feedback: Ok, Dont use stages just keep one stage with longer process but time limit should be 2min max
newGames.brief: Bloxorz clone: a 1x1x2 block rolls (swipe or on-screen arrows) across an isometric-looking tile board floating over a void. Falling off or overhanging the edge = fall & respawn at start (small time penalty). Board tiles labelled as life stages (First Job, Marriage, Home, Child, Retirement checkpoints that light up when crossed). ONE long single stage (~30-45 moves optimal) with bridges/switch tiles that toggle when rolled over, and fragile tiles that break if the block stands vertically on them. 2-minute countdown; reach the goal hole (drop block vertically into it) to win. Score = time remaining x10 + checkpoints crossed x200. Render with crisp pseudo-3D: top+side faces with gradient shading, soft drop shadow, smooth 150ms roll tween per move.

newGames.concept: Forward-rail crowd shooter (Battle Brigade / Mob Control style)
newGames.financialConcept: Building a stable bridge for long-term wealth
newGames.feedback: Ok, Replace army with virus and powerup with health shield that increases the firing power
newGames.brief: Auto-forward rail shooter: player character (blue guardian with glowing shield emblem) auto-runs along a bridge over water, auto-firing energy bolts forward. Drag horizontally to steer between 3 lanes. Waves of green virus blobs (varied sizes, HP shown as small bars) march toward the player; bolts damage them; a virus reaching the player drains health. Collect floating HEALTH SHIELD pickups (hex shield with cross) - each one restores health AND permanently increases fire rate/damage this run (stacking power). 90-second run to reach the vault at bridge end = win. Score = viruses destroyed x10 + shields collected x100 + health remaining bonus. Parallax water & sky, muzzle flashes, hit particles, boss virus at the end.

newGames.financialConcept: Matching the Life goals
newGames.feedback: Ok, Replace with Life goals: Shield, Savings, Home, Car, Education, Marriage, Child, Retirement, Health, Rewards, Family. Use better Assets for this not emoji
newGames.gameFeedback: Ok, But How to play must only have animation not text.
newGames.brief: Triple-match: a scattered pile of overlapping life-goal tokens (Shield, Savings coin, Home, Car, Education cap, Marriage rings, Child, Retirement chair, Health heart-pulse, Rewards gift, Family) rendered as premium layered inline-SVG icon sprites (gradient fills, inner highlights, soft shadows - absolutely no emoji). Tap a token to move it into a 7-slot tray at the bottom; 3 identical tokens in the tray auto-merge with a satisfying pop + particles. Tray full with no match = lose. Clear the whole board within 2 minutes = win. Tokens deeper in the pile are dimmed/locked until uncovered. ~60 tokens (20 triplets), gentle shuffle + 1 free undo + 1 magnet booster. Score = matches x100 + time bonus + tray-efficiency bonus. HOW-TO-PLAY MUST BE ANIMATION ONLY - no instructional text.

newGames.concept: Arrow sliding escape puzzle (Arrow Exit style)
newGames.financialConcept: Smart decisions
newGames.brief: Unblock-style arrow puzzle: a 6x6 grid packed with rounded arrow blocks, each pointing up/down/left/right. Tap an arrow: it slides in its pointing direction until it exits the board (collect + score) or hits another block (bump animation + tiny shake). Clear all arrows to finish the level; wrong-order taps waste moves. Blocks styled as sleek gradient chevrons in brand palette; risk blocks (red, marked with virus icon) must be cleared last or they lock neighbors - teaching order-of-decisions. 5 escalating boards inside a 2-minute timer, move counter, combo bonus for consecutive successful exits. Score = exits x50 + remaining time x10 - bumps x10.

newGames.concept: Hang glider / canyon gliding (Canyon Glider style)
newGames.financialConcept: Life-stage protection & wealth collection
newGames.feedback: Reference not opening - rebuilt from concept description
newGames.brief: Glider physics: hold to dive (gain speed), release to convert speed into lift and soar. Side-scrolling canyon with parallax rock layers; canyon ceiling/floor undulate. Collect gold wealth coins and blue shield tokens along flight arcs; shields grant 1-hit protection against red risk spikes/birds (virus-styled hazards). Distance milestones labelled as life stages (Graduation 200m, First Job 500m, Marriage 900m, Home 1400m, Retirement 2000m) with banner popups. Run ends on unshielded collision or at 2000m (win) or 105s cap. Score = distance + coins x25 + stages reached x300. Smooth camera, wind trail particles behind glider, day-sky gradient.

newGames.financialConcept: Risk structure elimination & rebuilding
newGames.feedback: Reference not opening - rebuilt from concept description
newGames.brief: Physics artillery puzzle: a fixed cannon at bottom-left; drag to aim (trajectory dots preview) and release to fire a glowing shield orb. Levels are structures of wooden planks/crates with green virus blobs perched on them. Shield orb + collapsing debris destroy viruses on contact; gravity + simple rigid-body tumble (rect bodies, rotation) makes structures cascade. Limited shots per level (3-5). 5 levels in a 2-minute session. Score = viruses cleared x150 + shots remaining x100 + demolition bonus. Squash-and-stretch on impacts, dust particles, slow-mo 0.3s on final virus of each level.

newGames.financialConcept: Bridging life's gaps - momentum of continuous protection
newGames.brief: Side-scrolling rope-swing traversal over a dusk canyon (parallax SVG backdrop layers). One-touch control: press-and-hold throws a rope to the nearest glowing shield anchor ahead and the guardian swings as a pendulum under gravity with light damping; release lets go, carrying the tangential speed into a projectile arc toward the next anchor. A generous auto-target radius, input buffering, and an assisted reach while falling keep near-misses connecting without steering input. Single 105-second run scrolling right toward the Retirement Vault at 2,000 m, with banner popups at Graduation 200m, First Job 500m, Marriage 900m, Home 1400m. Green virus orbs drift in the gaps (an unshielded touch knocks the guardian off the rope); blue shield tokens grant 1-hit protection; gold coins are laid along the ideal swing arcs, rewarding good release timing. Anchor spacing widens and virus density rises as the run progresses. Win: reach the vault. Lose: fall past the canyon floor, or the session timer expires. Score = coins x25 + milestones x300 + Perfect Release x50 (releasing on the forward low arc). Rope renders as a tapered curve with sag and a snap-taut animation on grab; synth audio for grab/release/coin/shield/win; no emoji sprites.

newGames.financialConcept: Navigating life's risks to reach each life milestone
newGames.brief: Portrait top-down lane-hopper rendered as flat-shaded pseudo-3D rows (top + front face gradients, soft drop shadows, no emoji sprites) on a fixed 48-row course from Start to Retirement, 7 columns wide. Tap hops forward one row; swipe left/right/down hops sideways or back; each hop is a ~120ms tween with a small arc, squash-and-stretch landing, and dust particles. Safe pavement rows carry occasional planter obstacles; risk roads stream green virus blobs across at lane-specific speeds and directions (unshielded contact ends the run, a shield token saves once); uncertainty rivers introduced after the Marriage milestone are crossable only by hopping onto drifting glowing coverage platforms. Six milestone rows (Graduation 8, First Job 16, Marriage 24, Home 32, Child 40, Retirement 48) are full-width safe bands with a banner popup and fanfare on first touch. A rising risk-tide fog from below punishes standing still, keeping the session moving alongside the 2-minute cap. Win: reach the Retirement row within the session. Lose: unshielded virus hit, river/fog, the tide, or timeout. Score = furthest row x10 + coins x25 + milestones x300 + time bonus on win (5 per second remaining).
newGames.reviewFeedback: BajajLife 2026-08-03: "The overall quality is below the expected standard." | RESOLVED - the hop was bound to the kit onTap, which fires on pointerup and charged every input the full 60-150ms contact; onSwipe was also wired, so one gesture fired two hops; and nothing checked destination occupancy, so ~35% of blind forward hops died with no counterplay. Casual win 46.0 -> 58.5%, brisk 56.0 -> 73.0%. Six milestones now bank a real corpus. The old debt sprite read as a handbag - rebuilt.

newGames.financialConcept: Asset allocation - fitting every asset class into a balanced portfolio
newGames.brief: 1010!-style: 9x9 board; three asset pieces offered at a time (tetromino-like shapes themed as asset classes: Equity=orange, Debt=blue, Gold=gold, Insurance=green with shield sheen). Drag pieces onto the board; completing a full row or column clears it with a sweep animation + particles ('Portfolio Rebalanced!'). No gravity, no rotation. Game ends when no offered piece fits (lose) or the 2-minute timer ends (score win). Clearing rows containing all 4 asset colors = Diversification Bonus x2. Score = cells placed + clears x100 + diversification bonuses. Ghost preview while dragging, invalid-drop shake, streak flames on multi-clears. Restored from archive commit 1cf30a9 after sign-off.

newGames.financialConcept: Riding market cycles - descend through volatility, avoid the crash zones
newGames.brief: Helix jump: a bouncing shield ball descends a rotating spiral tower; drag horizontally to rotate the tower (pseudo-3D platform arcs as ellipse segments with depth shading). Each ring has gaps (fall through to descend), safe blue arcs, and red crash arcs (touch = lose unless in fever). Passing 3+ rings in one fall = fever streak (ball flames, smashes through one red arc). 40 rings to the vault at the bottom = win; 2-minute cap. Rings labelled with descending years-to-retirement every 10 rings. Score = rings descended x20 + fever smashes x100 + finish bonus. Bounce squash, paint-splash on landing, tower gradient darkens with depth.

newGames.financialConcept: Market volatility & ULIP - disciplined investing through ups and downs
newGames.brief: Plinko: tap/drag to choose drop position at top, release a gold premium coin that bounces down through rows of glowing pegs (circle physics, restitution, slight randomness) into buckets at the bottom labelled with goal multipliers (Retirement x5, Home x3, Education x2, Savings x1, and 2 red Risk x0 buckets that flash). 10 coins per session (or 90s cap). Occasional blue shield peg: touching it shields the coin so a Risk bucket pays x1 instead of x0 - insurance smooths volatility. Running total with animated counter; combo streak for consecutive scoring buckets. Win = total payout above a tuned target. Peg hit sparkles, bucket win confetti bursts, coin trail.

newGames.financialConcept: De-risking your portfolio without destabilizing your life plan
newGames.brief: Physics tower: a 12-layer tower of alternating blocks; some are RED RISK blocks (high-interest debt, junk investment, virus icon), others BLUE FOUNDATION blocks (term cover, emergency fund). Tap-and-flick red blocks to pull them out; tower center-of-mass + wobble physics reacts - pull the wrong support and the tower sways; topple = lose. Remove ALL red blocks to win; a stability meter shows center-of-mass offset with heartbeat when critical. 2-minute cap. Score = risks removed x200 + stability average bonus + time bonus. Dust particles, slow tilt when leaning, dramatic collapse on loss.

newGames.financialConcept: Staying on track - disciplined orbit around your life goals
newGames.brief: Orbit timing: a comet circles a glowing goal planet. Tap to release tangentially and get captured by the next planet's orbit (Education, Car, Marriage... distinct vector-art planets). Time releases for clean transfer arcs; drifting green virus asteroids or flying off-screen cost a life (3 lives). Coins dot the transfer paths; every 5th planet is a MILESTONE banner + bonus. Speed rises gradually; 20 planets or 2-minute cap = win/lose. Score = planets reached x100 + coins x20 + perfect-transfer (no orbit >1 loop) x50. Orbit trails, gravity-well glow rings, star parallax.

newGames.financialConcept: Knock out risks in one decisive shot - comprehensive cover
newGames.brief: Bowling: pseudo-3D lane (perspective trapezoid with gloss reflections); 10 pins styled as green virus bottles (front pins labelled Illness, Accident, Debt, Inflation). Flick the glowing shield ball - flick speed sets power, angle sets direction, small post-flick curve via swipe curl. Ball-pin and pin-pin 2D collisions on the lane plane projected to perspective. 5 frames, 2 throws each with strike/spare bonuses and a simplified scorecard; 2-minute cap. Win = total pins above a tuned target. Pin explosion into particle shards on strike + STRIKE banner, gutter wobble, ball trail, crowd-cheer synth swell.

newGames.financialConcept: Keeping the family's cover in play - every save at the flippers is a premium paid on time
newGames.brief: Portrait pinball: hold-to-charge plunger launches the ball; tap-and-hold left/right screen halves for the flippers (rotating capsules with angular impulse). Table: 3 goal bumpers (Education / Home / Retirement), slingshot bulges on the funnel walls, 3 rollover lanes up top - lighting all 3 arms Bonus Secure (2x scoring, 8s). Circle-vs-segment physics with >=4 substeps at terminal speed (sim-proven no tunneling), restitution 0.55 walls / 1.15 bumpers with a 1500 px/s energy clamp. 3 balls, 120s clock; win at 3000 points. Anti-camp is pure geometry: a held flipper opens an outlane, so cradling scores worse than honest tapping.

newGames.financialConcept: Every ball is a life event - cover it with the right timing
newGames.brief: Cricket chase: 40 runs in 18 balls with 3 wickets. Bowler run-up telegraphs speed/length via a marker (3 speeds, +8% every 6 balls, slower balls from ball 7). One control: TAP to swing; timing error vs ideal contact gives PERFECT (boundary 4/6), GOOD (1-2 runs), EDGE (35% wicket chance) or MISS (wicket on stump-line balls). Deliveries themed as life events (Medical emergency yorker, Inflation bouncer); a PERFECT on every 6th Cover ball grants a one-wicket shield. Side-on ground with programmatic batter/bowler rigs, ball trail, boundary rope, FOUR!/SIX! floating text. Fixed-timestep render interpolation keeps judged timing jitter-free.
newGames.reviewFeedback: BajajLife 2026-08-03: batter misplaced, cannot hit reliably, collision inaccurate, no insurance objective, result screen off-template. | RESOLVED - there was NO collision test at all; shots were scored purely on tap timing against authored windows. Measured over 7,200 seeded deliveries, the blade actually touched the ball on 4.3% of the shots the game scored as hits. Replaced with swept segment-segment collision: 4450/4450 perfectly-timed swings now connect and middle. Four insurance zones with shaped payouts (Guaranteed Income provably cannot win alone). Result screen brought onto the shared template. EMAIL FIELD DELIBERATELY NOT ADDED - superseded by the repo-wide Name+Mobile decision.

newGames.concept: Steer a decaying cover span; renew before the event locks
newGames.financialConcept: Cover is bought in advance, lapses if unrenewed, and never stretches over everything at once
newGames.feedback: Rebuilt 2026-08-03 - BajajLife review found the original concept and execution incorrect
newGames.brief: The goal mouth is the interval [0,1] and the player owns a cover span whose HALF-WIDTH IS THE SUM ASSURED. Drag to steer it (slew-limited 0.72 mouth/sec); shots arrive at telegraphed points you do not choose. The term decays every second and every claim paid draws it down; the only way back is TAP to RENEW, which costs scarce premium and is LOCKED once a ball passes 55% of its flight. Full span covers 44% of the mouth while volleys spread to 48%, so which of the three family goals goes uncovered is the player's call. 78s, 5 announced phases. Measured: perfect positioning while never renewing wins 0.0%, the same positioning with renewals wins 99.3% - the 99-point gap is the whole economy. Reaction sweep 150-560ms is deliberately flat, so cover management separates players, not reflexes.
newGames.reviewFeedback: BajajLife 2026-08-03: "The entire game concept and execution are incorrect", and separately (as "Goal Area") "looks completely AI-generated and lacks visual identity". Both notes are this one game. | REBUILT - the cover span, whose half-width IS the sum assured, decays every second and is renewable only before the event locks at 55% of ball flight. Measured: perfect positioning while never renewing wins 0.0%; identical positioning with renewals wins 99.3%. The reaction sweep is deliberately flat, so cover management separates players, not reflexes.

newGames.concept: Carrom flick-pocket physics (drag striker, pull to aim)
newGames.financialConcept: Pocket every goal - the Queen of Protection only stays yours if you cover her
newGames.brief: Top-down carrom with 4 corner pockets: drag the striker along the baseline, pull back to aim (aim line + power meter), release to flick. 9 gold wealth coins (+100), 1 red Queen of Protection (+500, must be covered by pocketing a gold coin on the very next strike or she returns to center) and 2 dark risk discs (-150 and a foul). Exponential friction decay (half-life ~0.45s), disc-disc restitution 0.92, striker returns each strike. 8 strikes, 120s; win at 6+ gold-equivalent coins, lose on 3 fouls. Physics hardened by a multi-seed gate: 17 seeds / 26k runs with zero pieces ever escaping the felt.
newGames.reviewFeedback: BajajLife 2026-08-03: weak carrom design, no bot opponent, no proper sliding/flicking control. | RESOLVED - the controls and fixed-step physics already existed and worked; they were re-verified rather than rewritten. The bot genuinely did not exist: the ghost-ball planner was imported only by the balance sim, never by the shipped bundle, so the game was solo score-attack. Bot now ships at three difficulties (89.4 / 71.9 / 55.0% against a skilled reference, random 21.3 / 11.3 / 5.0%). Anti-tunnelling proven by swept closest-approach: 880 max-power strikes, 452,813 ticks, 0 pass-throughs. 0 draws in 960 matches.

newGames.concept: Goal-funding triage with forecast shocks and a fixed-premium cover decision
newGames.financialConcept: A fixed premium against a proportional loss - cover is worth buying on the big position, not the small one
newGames.feedback: Mechanic replaced 2026-08-03 - BajajLife review found press-your-luck provided no meaningful value; the old gate measured a zero-information bot at 55% of the skilled score
newGames.brief: Three life goals inflate side by side, each showing its target, deadline and current value. HOLD a balloon to pour income in, slide to switch. Income refills 24/s and drains 76/s, so all three can never be funded. Shocks are FORECAST 4s ahead on a named goal with the exact money they will take printed on the badge; one tap buys cover for a fixed 28. Nothing is hidden - no threshold, no coin flip. Because the premium is fixed and the exposure is a percentage of the position, the same 28 is obviously right against a balloon holding 180 and obviously wrong against one holding 30. Because drain is 3x refill, funding flat out means never affording a premium. 90s, win at 1000. Skill gap 87.5pp (skilled 87.5% / casual 31.9% / random 0.0%).
newGames.reviewFeedback: BajajLife 2026-08-03: "The selected game format does not provide meaningful value." | MECHANIC REPLACED - the old gate condemned it: a bot with zero information scored 55% of the skilled result, because hold-and-release has one degree of freedom per round. A hidden random burst threshold also told players their money evaporates unpredictably, the wrong message for an insurer. Now goal-funding triage with shocks forecast 4s ahead and a fixed-premium cover decision. Skill gap 17.4pp -> 87.5pp.

newGames.financialConcept: Route every rupee of income to the goals that matter - seal the leaks before payday flows
newGames.brief: 3 pipe-grid levels (4x4, 5x5, 6x6): tap tiles (straight / elbow / tee / cross) to rotate 90 degrees and connect the Salary tap on the left edge to Education / Home / Retirement tanks on the right before the payday timer (18/22/26s) triggers the flow. Money animates cell-to-cell; every open pipe end on the path leaks -25, each tank filled +150, early-finish bonus for connecting before the timer. Levels are generated from a solved layout and scrambled within proven bands; solvability and par (<= 14 rotations) are verified by a Steiner-tree DP in the gate. Win by filling all tanks on all 3 levels inside 120s.
newGames.reviewFeedback: BajajLife 2026-08-03: "The game is not functioning." | RESOLVED - no crash; it built clean and passed its gate while ending the run ~18s in, because a dry board called endRun and level 1 had an 18s clock, so boards 2 and 3 never appeared. A dry board now costs the level only; timers 26/28/32s; win bar moved off all-six-tanks (even the greedy bot clears that only 78% of the time). Run 18s -> 91s.

newGames.financialConcept: Protect it, grow it, or bin it - sort your money life before it scrolls past
newGames.brief: Items ride a conveyor into a sorting head: SWIPE LEFT = Protect shelf (term plan, health cover, critical illness, accident shield), SWIPE RIGHT = Grow shelf (SIP, mutual fund, bonds, gold), SWIPE DOWN = bin (scam call, impulse buy, lottery ticket). Cards are programmatic with distinct icon families - shield vs chart vs hazard. Missort or a missed item = 1 of 3 mistakes; conveyor speeds up 6% every 5 items; every 10th item is a glowing 2x urgent at 1.5x speed. Combo multiplier x1 to x5 on consecutive correct sorts. Win: survive the 90s run under 3 mistakes with score >= 1200.
newGames.reviewFeedback: BajajLife 2026-08-03: "The game is not working." | RESOLVED - no crash, and input was fine (a scripted drag moved the score). 3 lives against 12 unfamiliar item types at 1.9s/card killed a first-timer on the opening three cards; run over in 11s. Added a 3-card grace that still flashes red and breaks combo but cannot spend a life. Budget stays 3 - raising it to 5 sent the casual bot to 83.4%, outside the 25-45% band.

newGames.financialConcept: Life's traffic never stops - one Claim Cushion, and after that timing is everything
newGames.brief: Top-down 4-way junction: family vehicles (car / scooter / school van) spawn on four approaches at ramping frequency; TAP a vehicle to brake-hold it, tap again to release. Unstoppable risk trucks (10% of spawns, horn + flash) never brake - time everyone else around them. Two vehicles overlapping in the junction crash; the first crash is forgiven by the single Claim Cushion, the second ends the run. Each driver has a cumulative run-wide patience budget (telegraphed by a draining arc) so parking traffic forever backfires - the park exploit is sim-proven dead (96% to 5%). Win: 20 vehicles safely through within 110s; near-misses pay a smart-timing bonus.
newGames.reviewFeedback: BajajLife 2026-08-03: "The user interface requires major improvement." | RESOLVED - the third HUD row sat on top of the southbound traffic lane at 320x568. Collapsed to one top card plus two chips on a city block, which never has traffic under it. The junction box is now the danger indicator: open green brackets when clear, filled red triangles plus a pulsing outline when contested - a shape and motion swap, not colour alone. Red now means exactly one thing; held moved to brand blue.

newGames.concept: Ice-slide pathing puzzle (swipe, glide to wall)
newGames.financialConcept: One swipe at a time, glide your shield past thin ice and bring it home to the family
newGames.brief: 5 handcrafted frozen-grid levels (7x9): swipe and the shield token glides until it hits a wall, rock or edge, collecting coins it passes over; reach the family tile to clear the level. Crack tiles break when slid ONTO (fall = level restart, -1 of 3 retries) but are safe to cross at speed once, visibly deepening; later levels add a telegraphed wind gust that shifts the token one cell sideways. Levels are ASCII maps in levels.js with BFS-proven pars, coins on optimal lines, and no reachable dead-end states (crack breaks can never make a level unsolvable). Win: all 5 levels inside 120s and retries; par-move finishes pay a bonus.
newGames.reviewFeedback: BajajLife 2026-08-03: "Both the user interface and gameplay mechanics need improvement." | RESOLVED - swept collision with 1,600 slides swept and 0 tunnelling; all 5 boards proven solvable at the published par with every pickup inside par+2 and no reachable dead ends; cover points and gusts verified load-bearing. Skilled bot 48.7% against random 0.0%. Survives the full 120s clock at every handset size.

newGames.concept: Rate-limited cover-level management against partially-hidden incoming claims
newGames.financialConcept: Under-insuring is cheap until the event arrives; over-insuring is safe but spends money the goals needed
newGames.feedback: Rebuilt 2026-08-03 - BajajLife review found the experience did not feel like a game
newGames.brief: A cover line the player drags; claims scroll toward a NOW line publishing only their size BAND (routine 10-24%, major 30-56%, critical 55-88%), with the actual size revealed 0.72s out. Cover raises at 0.52/s and drops at 1.30/s, so 0.72s buys enough to fix a routine misread but not to rescue a critical one off the floor: you commit from the band, then shave on the reveal. Under-cover drains family security on a super-linear curve (gap^1.6), over-cover drains the budget meter, and either at zero ends the run - two opposed lose conditions. Gold goal tokens ride low, so only a player who is not over-insuring can reach them. 8 chapters, ages 25-60, ~96s. Skilled scores 13.5x random, asserted as a hard gate condition.
newGames.reviewFeedback: BajajLife 2026-08-03: "The current experience does not feel like a game." | REBUILT - was a stop-the-marker toy. Now real-time cover management: claims publish a size band and reveal the true value 0.72s out; cover raises slowly and drops fast, so you commit from the band and shave on the reveal. Under-cover drains security on a super-linear curve, over-cover drains budget - two opposed lose conditions. Skilled scores 13.5x random, asserted as a hard gate condition so it cannot regress into a calculator.

newGames.financialConcept: Life's expenses keep coming - keep your cover airborne and glide through every one
newGames.brief: Portrait side-scroller: a shield-glider carrying the family's cover flies right under gravity; TAP gives a fixed upward impulse. Paired expense-wall pillars scroll in, each labelled as a life expense (School fees, Medical bill, EMI hike); passing the gap = a premium kept on time. Gold coins line the flight path; a blue shield token every ~8 gates absorbs one collision. Gap narrows 34% -> 24%, scroll speed steps up at gates 9 and 17, later gaps drift on a telegraphed sine. Win: 24 gates inside 100s; lose on unshielded contact or the clock. Near-miss bonus pays for brave lines; gate proves every generated gap sequence is physically passable.
newGames.reviewFeedback: Assigned elsewhere per the BajajLife 2026-08-03 review ("Already taken"). No work initiated.

newGames.financialConcept: A premium on every beat - stay in rhythm, skip the temptations, and cover never misses
newGames.brief: Rhythm game synced to a synth metronome groove: rings contract from the screen edge toward a glowing policy badge in exact beat time. TAP when a blue ring (premium due) reaches the badge - within 45ms is PERFECT, 110ms GOOD; red spiky rings (impulse buys) must be let through WITHOUT tapping. Three movements at BPM 96 -> 112 -> 126 across 90s with ~64 scored rings and half-beat bonus doubles every 8th beat. 8 misses = cover lapsed. Taps are stamped at pointerdown against the audio clock with a documented device-latency allowance - the timing model is honest, sim-verified with human jitter.

newGames.financialConcept: A financial plan only works if you remember every step - recall it in order, skip the risky detours
newGames.brief: A 3x3 grid of premium vector goal tiles (Health, Home, Education, Retirement, Travel, Family, Savings, Wedding, Emergency), each with its own synth pitch so sequences play as melodies. The family's plan lights up tiles in order (length 3 -> 9 across 7 rounds, playback speeding 460 -> 300ms); reproduce it by tapping. From round 4 one step is a red risk flash that must be SKIPPED during recall. Wrong tile or 5s idle = a slip; 3 slips = the plan is forgotten. Ordered recall only - no card flipping, no pair matching. Win: complete round 7 inside 110s.
newGames.reviewFeedback: BajajLife 2026-08-03: "The colours are too dull." | RESOLVED - resting tiles were painted as the goal hue at ~15% alpha over navy, which desaturates it, compositing nine distinct goals into nine identical mud rectangles. New opaque colorRest per goal; rest-to-lit luminance jump now 2.6-4.6x. Tile labels sub-AA -> 15.56:1 via one scrim plate. Every state pairs colour with a shape (tick / X / circle-slash / strike / ring). Gate byte-identical.

newGames.financialConcept: Life comes at you fast - pay, protect, pick and plan in seconds; that is what good cover feels like
newGames.brief: 12 rapid micro-challenges per run, drawn from a pool of 14+, each a single verb in 3.5s shrinking to 2.6s under a one-word command banner: PAY! (tap the premium before the due stamp slams), SWAT! (swipe away the scam call), PICK! (tap the right cover card), SHIELD! (drag the umbrella over the family), GROW! (hold-fill the SIP jar to the line), SIGN!, CATCH!, SNOOZE!, STAMP!, SPLIT!, LOCK!, TOP-UP!, GIFT!, WAKE!. 3 lives; speed-up jingle every 4th game; difficulty tiers easy -> hard. Win: clear all 12 in a ~75-100s run. Every microgame is individually gate-proven clearable at the hardest tier.
newGames.reviewFeedback: BajajLife 2026-08-03: "The game objective and mechanics are unclear." | RESOLVED with zero rule changes - every microgame already declared a verb that was never shown to the player, and the failure countdown was painted underneath the HUD pills, occluded on every handset. Added a persistent instruction frame (verb chip + ask + money moment), a 12-segment progression track, captioned shield pips and a visible WAIT/GO cue. Gate numbers identical, which is the proof the rules were untouched.

newGames.financialConcept: Layered protection - every upgrade between waves is another rider on the family's cover
newGames.brief: Arena survivor: blue guardian auto-fires at the nearest green virus ONLY while stationary - moving stops firing (stutter-step tension is the whole game). Floating joystick, 400x600 arena. Enemy archetypes: chaser (65% player speed), shooter (450ms telegraphed wind-up, projectile slower than player), splitter (2 minis on death, 300ms harmless scatter). 4 waves over 90s ending in a telegraphed 3-shot-fan mini-boss; between waves pick 1 of 3 glassmorphic rider cards (multishot, ricochet, pierce, fire rate 'Auto-Pay', damage 'Top-Up', Health Rider, 'Claim Settled' heal, move speed). 4 HP, 900ms i-frames, spawns >=150px away and harmless for 600ms, quadrant-biased spawns + flanking to kill corner camping. Win: survive all 4 waves. Lose: HP 0. Score = kills x tier + wave bonuses. Re-acquire 3-2-1 countdown on visibility resume with the session clock held.

newGames.financialConcept: A premium on every note - never miss a payment and the family's plan plays like music
newGames.feedback: Proposed 2026-07-29 - pending BajajLife sign-off. Note: an earlier premium-tiles concept was removed in the 2026-07-28 scope cut for lacking sign-off; this is a fresh implementation of the explicitly requested piano-tiles genre
newGames.brief: 4-lane tile tapper where each successful tap plays the next note of a hand-composed 160-note pentatonic melody - the player performs the song, and breaking flow breaks the music. ~90s chart of 160 scorable tiles: HOLD tiles (sustained note, banked score per 200ms), DOUBLE tiles (two lanes within a 100ms pairing window), and red risk tiles (IMPULSE BUY / SCAM CALL, exactly 10%) that must NOT be tapped. 3 lives; empty-lane tap, red tap, or an expired blue tile costs one; 120ms late grace; double-taps never punished. Speed +10% every 15s (announced SPEED UP steps, cap 1.7x). Combo x2/x3/x4 at 25/50/75. Win: finish the chart with a life left; stars by Perfect %. Anti-spam: >8 taps/s under 50% accuracy counts extras as misses; hits require discrete pointerdown. Frozen-clock 3-2-1 re-acquire on resume.

newGames.financialConcept: Compounding in your hands - small savings merge into life goals
newGames.brief: Drop-merge jar: drag to aim, release to drop wealth tokens; two same-tier tokens merge into the next tier at the contact midpoint with a pop that jostles neighbours into chain cascades. 8 hand-drawn vector tiers (radius x1.35): Rupee Coin -> Coin Stack -> Gold Ingot -> Piggy Bank -> SIP Jar -> Gold Shield -> Home -> glowing Retirement Corpus. Hand-rolled deterministic circle physics (gravity 1500, restitution 0.15, fixed-step substeps, headless-verified). Danger line at 18% from the top arms only when a resting token sits above it for a continuous 2.0s (flashing line + heartbeat) - transient bounces never lose, enabling last-second merge-out comebacks. Chain multipliers x1/x1.5/x2/x3; triangular tier scores 1..36. 100s session; win by creating the Corpus or score >=300; 5s auto-drop kills timer-stalling. Frozen-clock re-acquire countdown on resume.
newGames.reviewFeedback: BajajLife 2026-08-03: "The assets and colour combinations are too basic." | RESOLVED - tier colours were an arbitrary rainbow, so tier 5 read as worth LESS than tier 4, and Piggy Bank outranked Gold Reserve. Replaced with a bronze-gold-platinum-diamond ladder climbing on six channels (body luminance, glow, rim pips, facets, orbiting motes, radius), none regressing. New scripts/tier-ladder.mjs guards the ranking contract and caught two contrast defects mid-build.

newGames.concept: Fruit Ninja-style swipe slicer (slash risks, spare shields)
newGames.financialConcept: Cut the risks out of the family's life - cover is the blade
newGames.feedback: Proposed 2026-07-29 - pending BajajLife sign-off. Note: bajaj-game-store catalog lists a fruit-slice game; this differentiates via the protect-the-Family-Shield rule (slicing blue shield orbs is the penalty) and risk-labelled targets
newGames.brief: Swipe slicer: green spiky risk orbs (Scam Call, Hidden Fees, Debt Trap, Inflation, Medical Bill, Impulse Buy) are lobbed up in readable ballistic arcs; a glowing tapering blade trail slices them into two spinning halves with goo bursts. Slices register only at blade speed >=400 px/s (slow drags cut nothing); 1.15x forgiving hitboxes. Blue Family Shield orbs must NOT be sliced (calm glow + chime + telegraph puff, enforced >=1.2x path separation from every risk so nothing is un-sliceable): -10 and a 1s stun each, 3 sliced = lose. Combos 3+ per gesture (+2x(N-2), cap 8), 5+ in one swipe = 1s slow-mo. FRENZY windows: x3 spawns, zero shields. 90s ramp from 1-2 orbs/1.6s to 3-5/0.9s + finale frenzy. Win: score >=120. Frozen-clock 3-2-1 re-acquire on resume with stale blade trail cleared.
newGames.reviewFeedback: Assigned elsewhere per the BajajLife 2026-08-03 review ("Already taken"). No work initiated.

newGames.concept: Ketchapp Stack-style timing tower (trim on miss, regrow on perfects)
newGames.financialConcept: Every layer is a monthly SIP - discipline compounds, and consistency repairs old mistakes
newGames.feedback: Proposed 2026-07-29 - pending BajajLife sign-off. Note: bajaj-game-store catalog lists a stacking game; this differentiates via SIP milestone framing and the perfect-streak width-regrowth loop
newGames.brief: Timing tower: a pseudo-3D slab slides linearly above the tower (constant speed, alternating entry side, random phase); tap to drop, judged at the pointerdown timestamp so latency never eats a perfect. Overlap survives, overhang shears off as a physics chunk; total miss or width <8px = lose. PERFECT window max(12px, 10% width) snaps with an expanding ring + rising pitch ladder; from the 3rd consecutive perfect the slab regrows +12% of original width per perfect - skilled play visibly undoes past mistakes. Speed steps at layers 11 and 21; camera rises with a 250ms lerp; background hue drifts 3 deg/layer; SIP milestone banners every 6th layer (Year 1, Year 5, Home, Education, Retirement Corpus). Win: 30 layers = summit zoom-out + confetti; ~60-100s untimed session. Best score persisted with a delta line to fuel one-more-try. Resume re-randomises slab phase/direction behind a 3-2-1 countdown so pausing yields zero aiming info.
newGames.reviewFeedback: BajajLife 2026-08-03: "The user interface and stacking blocks are not properly designed." | RESOLVED - one geometry source: slabFaces() is the only description of a block shape, the renderer fills exactly those polygons and the drop is judged on exactly the same footprint. Asserted across 224 widths from 12px to 122.8px at 0.000px disagreement, so a drop that looks perfect can no longer be trimmed. Drop judged at pointerdown. Corpus compounds so the first surviving layer ends worth 9.7x the last. OPEN: casual bot wins 0.0% against skilled 96.7% - a sharp cliff, though the results screen grades in tiers rather than pass/fail.

newGames.concept: Time-loop past-self co-op (previous runs replay as live ghost helpers)
newGames.financialConcept: Your past contributions keep working for you - every premium your past self paid protects the family today
newGames.brief: 5 loops x 18s on one hand-authored vault map: each finished loop replays as a live echo (max 4, hue-shifted, badge) whose recorded positions still hold pressure plates, block hazard beams and sync twin levers. Doors need 1/2/3 distinct bodies simultaneously; the final run carries the policy chest through doors your ghosts hold open. Ghost replay is a 60Hz state track (Float32Array of x,y,actionBits - pure playback, divergence-proof); world events keyed to a single master loop clock + session seed so every loop is bit-identical. Win: chest delivered before loop 5 ends. Score = 1000 delivery + 400 x unused loops + 60/coin - plate-redundancy penalty. AFK loops burn early at 4s. Gate-proven: expert plan wins in 4 loops on 5 seeds, idle bot never wins, replay timelines byte-identical, pause freezes the one clock.
newGames.reviewFeedback: BajajLife 2026-08-03: "The purpose of the game is difficult to understand." | RESOLVED by deleting, not explaining - the time-loop mechanic was competing with four unrelated ones (hazard beam, twin levers, five coins, a third gate) plus an invisible score penalty. All removed; loops 18s -> 12s. An in-game objective coach replaces any instruction wall. Two traps closed: an unwinnable loop-1 chest grab, and loop 1 burning at 3s while the player was still reading. The animated how-to demo had never worked.

newGames.concept: Qix/JezzBall territory capture (claim ground, wall risks out)
newGames.financialConcept: Ring-fence the family's wealth - a real asset-protection term made playable
newGames.brief: 6px-cell grid (65x117): ride the claimed boundary at 300 px/s, cut into open field with 90-degree turns; sealing flood-fills every hazard-free component behind a 900 px/s color wave. 2 green risk orbs (250 to 300 px/s ramp) reflect in unclaimed space - touching your unfinished trail or body costs 1 of 3 lives; a 3rd orb spawns at 65% claimed or t=55s with a warning ring. Big single cuts pay multipliers (>=10% x1.5, >=20% x2.5, >=30% x4) priced by trail exposure. Anti-stall fuse chases a stopped trail; orbs speed up if you never claim. Win: 70% claimed within 90s. Score = cells + multipliers + time + lives + near-misses. Gate-proven: strip bot >=70% on 6/6 seeds, idle and boundary-camper never win, 106 seals with zero wrong-side claims and monotonic claimed %.
newGames.reviewFeedback: BajajLife 2026-08-03: "The visual design is average and lacks polish." | RESOLVED - the stage left ~128px of dead canvas under the field at 390x844, with HUD pills and the mute button floating in it. Field now sized as plot + one HUD band; no letterbox at any size. Surveyor's-plot art direction with glow and pulse amplitudes reduced rather than increased. Added a goal rail - the win condition was previously only words. Trade-off: 412x700 loses 10% field height.

newGames.concept: Darkness + sonar pulse navigation (perception as a resource)
newGames.financialConcept: You cannot see risks coming - your cover can; send the radar, read the danger, walk the family home
newGames.brief: Pitch-black maze: hidden geometry is never rendered at any alpha - a tapped sonar pulse (460 px/s ring, 1.6s cooldown) lights only wavefront-intersected wall segments for ~1.7s (walls white, hazards red, exit gold). Noise has a price: a lurker within 320px of a pulse stalks the pulse ORIGIN, so reposition after pinging. Escort 2 family followers through a ~2600px maze (3 gate checkpoints, corridors narrowing 72/56/48px) in 100s with 3 hearts. Fairness invariant enforced in code: nothing hits you unrevealed - lurkers self-ring inside 250px, cruise slower than you, and shriek 500ms before every lunge. Score = hearts + time + hidden orbs + quiet bonus (<=18 pulses). Pause blacks out all revealed geometry instantly (no pause-scouting), 3-2-1 re-acquire on resume. Gate: bot completes with hearts to spare; 10k random walks show every heart loss was telegraphed; pulse-spam scores worse than quiet play.
newGames.reviewFeedback: BajajLife 2026-08-03 (named "Ripple Radar"): "The game and its mechanics are difficult to understand." | RESOLVED - one meaning per surface (touching the maze always walks; radar is its own button). Six-signal vocabulary defined once and distinguishable in greyscale. Only static geometry is remembered, so a live lurker never leaves a lying ghost. Darkness now governs how far ahead you can plan, not whether you can see. Fixed a round-line-cap compositing bug that rendered the whole map dotted. Gate 16 -> 21 checks.

revamps.feedback: Ok, Make single player: replace the other human opponent with virus targets; ONLY our player can fire (no return fire)
revamps.brief: REVAMP per explicit feedback: convert from 2-archer duel to single-player target shooting. The opponent archer is REMOVED and replaced by green virus creatures (varied sizes/distances, some drifting or bobbing) that NEVER fire back. Player drags to aim (angle+power with trajectory hint for first 3 shots), arrows arc with gravity + light wind (wind indicator). Limited arrows (12) per 2-minute session; viruses spawn in waves at varying ranges; headshot-style direct hits = CRITICAL x2. Also: rename title/branding to Guardian Archer everywhere (index.html title, intro screen, OKF), keep/polish the lead-capture + slot booking + playCount flow to the GAME_STANDARD.md standard, ensure no emoji sprites, verify pnpm build passes.

revamps.feedback: Ok, Replace crows with risks {Risk = Green virus} Remove wire, it must be on flat ground.
revamps.brief: REVAMP polish pass to GAME_STANDARD.md: audit gameplay feel (input latency, difficulty curve, 60fps), visual juice (particles, screen shake, floating text, parallax background), synth audio coverage, no emoji sprites, glassmorphic UI, lead capture + slot booking + playCount correctness, mobile viewport + touch handling, 2-min session. Per feedback: REMOVE the wire entirely - the runner must move on flat ground - and replace the crow hazards with green virus risks; collectibles as shields/coins with premium vector art. Verify pnpm build passes and update OKF files.
